report.headline: Ads keywords tightened for winter; GHL source tracking corrected

done.text: Refined the winter campaign keywords: cut the list from 34 to 11, added 6 high-intent searches (furnace repair, no heat, emergency repair, furnace tune-up), and paused keywords that spent budget without producing leads.
Added negative keywords to block competitor names, troubleshooting searches, and equipment-shopping queries so budget focuses on people ready to book.
Fixed contact source attribution in the CRM: tags and lead sources are now assigned automatically based on where each contact comes from, replacing the manual process.

in_progress.text: Auditing the web lead tracking flow to ensure campaign and channel data is correctly captured and passed through on all paid traffic pages, so every form submission is properly attributed.
Burr Ridge Google listing verification is still pending — waiting on the new signage to be installed before the live video verification step can be completed.

Google Business Profile posting has been restarted for both Quality HVAC and Fibid after a gap since 9/29; first posts are being prepared this week with a weekly seasonal heating cadence planned going forward.

waiting_on_you.text: Burr Ridge verification: once the new "Fibid Heating & Air Conditioning" signage (door, lobby directory, and inside decal) is installed, please let us know so we can walk you through the Google live video verification from your own login.

next_week.text: Complete the web lead tracking audit and confirm UTM/source parameters are visible on every lead record.
Publish the first Google Business Profile post for Quality HVAC and Fibid and confirm the planned weekly posting day for each.
